quotes.text: At revision 0d8ec7dee44a3d9cc02b742c1d76ffc553fbc9b5, SearchDialog.js selects one of four offline news search scopes. It checks the folder's Offline flag for body availability and compares the inherited dob ayes setting (exact identifier: dobayes.mailnews@mozilla.org#junk) with "true" for junk availability. Both select localNewsJunkBody; junk alone selects localNewsJunk; body alone selects localNewsBody; neither selects localNews. Preserve these separate cases when changing news search scope selection. This is static source evidence for the news branch, not a rule for IMAP or proof of runtime behavior.

source.basis: Recorded interpretation. Original private evidence is unavailable to other consumers; this summary is not independent verification.
